description: Read the settings of the user's Parfumo account: notifications and privacy toggles, website options (display, mailbox, shelves, Souk pause), and on request gender, country and time zone (`page: "personal_details"`). Each setting comes with its name (`field`), label, current value and choices. Long choice lists (countries, time zones) are returned with `options_of` and `search`. Requires a linked Parfumo account.

SettingsPage.description: The settings pages of an account.

oneOf.description: Website language and display, mailbox, shelves, Souk.

options_of.description: Name of a setting whose choices are wanted in full (e.g. "country_id", "time_zone_id").

page.description: Settings page to read: `notifications` (notifications and privacy), `website` or `personal_details`. Default: notifications and website.

search.description: With `options_of`: only the choices whose label contains this text.

name: parfumo_get_settings

SettingOption.description: One choice of a setting that takes a value from a list.

value.description: Value to pass to change the setting.

SettingOut.description: One setting with its current value.

field.description: Name of the setting: pass it to parfumo_update_settings.

options.description: Choices of a `choice` setting; omitted when there are more than 30 (use `options_of`).

options_total.description: Number of choices of a `choice` setting.

value.description: Current value; absent when the page does not mark the selected choice.

SettingsPage.description: The settings pages of an account.

oneOf.description: Website language and display, mailbox, shelves, Souk.

options.description: With `options_of`: the choices of that setting (filtered by `search`).
